newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks drop at open, profit-takers abound.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks drop at open, profit-takers abound.

text.p: * Toronto's key stock index tumbled after the bell on Friday, hurt by profit-taking after days of steady gains. * Golds only gainers. * 8 million shares traded worth C$117 million.
Bearish investors prowled the Toronto stock market at Friday's open, selling holdings to reap profits after days of steady increases.
"It's time for the market to take a pause," said C.M. Oliver & Co Ltd's senior vice-president Peter Chandler.

Market players are turning their attention to other issues as the corporate earnings season for the second quarter rolls to a close, Chandler said, and interest rate concerns are starting to resurface.
Some feel U.S. economic growth will spike higher in the third quarter, increasing the chance of a rate hike, he said.
